**Draft**

Your dog's annual visit should include more than vaccines, especially after age 7. Bloodwork can show changes in kidney and liver function, blood sugar, and other health markers before symptoms appear. Testing every year also gives your veterinarian a baseline to compare against as your dog ages. Our senior wellness panel is $129 and can be added to the yearly checkup.

**Remaining patterns**

- The "more than vaccines" opener is a mild contrast, but it tells the reader something they may not know, so I kept it.
- The closing sentence in the original was sales language ("practical way to get a fuller picture," "make the most of"). I replaced it with the price and how to get the panel.
- I removed both em dashes and the curly apostrophe.
- "Can be added to the yearly checkup" restates what the original implied ("make the most of their yearly checkup"). I added no new facts.
